The party won 39 seats, equaling the number of seats for all other parties combined. Sahra Wagenknecht's BSW party, narrowly crossing the electoral threshold with five seats, indicated its readiness to cooperate with the AfD.

headlines.snippet: Germany's far-right AfD party achieved a victory in the Saxony-Anhalt election, although it did not secure an outright majority. The party celebrated the result as 'historic,' but forming a government remains uncertain.

headlines.snippet: Palestinians have launched a campaign titled #TheyLiedtoYou to challenge the narrative surrounding a 'ceasefire' in Gaza. The campaign aims to highlight what they describe as Israel's ongoing actions in the besieged enclave.

headlines.snippet: Iran's Minister of Roads and Urban Development, Farzaneh Sadegh, and Azerbaijan’s Deputy Prime Minister, Shahin Mustafayev, discussed expanding economic and transit cooperation. The meeting focused on infrastructure cooperation between Tehran and Baku.

headlines.title: Yemeni army launches drone attack on Saudi-affiliated militia positions in Taiz
headlines.snippet: The Yemeni armed forces launched multiple drones targeting positions of Saudi-backed militias in Taiz. Simultaneously, an explosion was heard in the city. The report is from IRNA.

headlines.snippet: The health ministry in Gaza stated that the death toll from Israeli attacks has risen to 73,651, with 174,575 people wounded. The figures were reported on Saturday.

headlines.snippet: Mexico's ambassador to Tehran, Guillermo Puente Ordorica, welcomed the formation of a joint committee to boost Iran-Mexico trade relations. Potential areas of cooperation include health tourism and the automotive industry.

headlines.title: US military cannot call its ‘barbaric crimes’ against civilians a ‘mistake’: Iran’s OIC mission
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA –Iran’s mission to the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) has denounced the US military for proudly acknowledging yet another “cowardly and illegal attack” on an Iranian oil tanker, while evading responsibility for the killing of civilians.

headlines.snippet: Iran's ballistic missile attack on a US carrier and destroyer is seen as more than a battlefield event, signaling a shift in regional deterrence and increasing the cost of America's naval presence. This analysis is from MNA.

headlines.title: Hormuz Strait fully closed; non-compliant ships to be banned
headlines.snippet: Major General Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, declared the Strait of Hormuz completely closed. He stressed that non-compliant ships will be prevented from crossing. This announcement was reported by MNA.

headlines.title: VIDEO: IRGC Navy releases footage of Strait of Hormuz control
headlines.snippet: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy has released footage showing its surveillance and actions against vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. This is the first time such footage has been published, according to MNA.

headlines.title: Economic pressure, blockade to cost US more than Iran
headlines.snippet: The IRGC spokesman stated that the US economic blockade against Iran is costing Washington more than Tehran. He asserted that the Iranian nation will not yield to pressure or sanctions. This statement was made on Sunday and reported by MNA.

headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Sep. 06 (MNA) – Iran's economy ministry has set up a dedicated economic war headquarters to centrally identify wartime disruptions and find executive solutions.

headlines.snippet: Senior cleric Ahmad Alamolhoda is reportedly seeking support to become the president of Iran’s Assembly of Experts. This assembly is responsible for selecting and overseeing the supreme leader.

headlines.snippet: Satellite images indicate a sharp decrease in shipping activity at Shahid Rajaee and Imam Khomeini ports since the reimposition of the US naval blockade. This underscores the increasing pressure on Iran's trade.

headlines.snippet: Donald Trump has reiterated his statement that the United States may soon strike 'Pickaxe Mountain,' an underground complex near Natanz linked to Iran's nuclear program. This site has remained untouched after two wars.

headlines.title: 4 INSIGHT Iran's appliance industry is collapsing, and so is the market it was built for
headlines.snippet: Iran's appliance industry is reportedly collapsing due to a lack of raw materials and declining consumer purchasing power. The industry has lost two key industrial hubs since March.

headlines.snippet: A debate is widening in Tehran regarding whether Iran is using its strongest leverage in the Strait of Hormuz. Warnings suggest the Strait could lose effectiveness if restrictions continue.
